in_progress.title: PHASE 1 of CARD-012: public watch page at /live/<CODE> (shareable, read-only, no admin key)
in_progress.description: A shareable, addressable public watch URL — the thing a kid can send a friend ('come watch me at /live/MAIN'). It reuses the ALREADY-SHIPPED read-only spectator socket verbatim (server.js:3419-3471, /ws?room=CODE&spectate=1 — the same socket the homepage preview and Storyboard previews ride): no new WS message types, no admin key, no chat input, no draw tools. Behind it the server already enforces the owner's entire moderation stance: kid_safe + listed rooms only (private/friends rooms refused with room_blocked/not_watchable), MAX_SPECTATORS=40 per room, every inbound frame from a spectator ignored, headcount-only roster (never names). New work is thin and additive: PublicWatch.jsx renders the live canvas + a read-only banter strip (same allowlist the homepage already shows) + an honest empty state when nobody is drawing + a 'Join and draw →' CTA to /join/<CODE>, plus a client-only random animal alias ('watching as 🦊 Quiet Fox 42') so no sign-in or real name is ever requested. The admin glass room at /watch/<CODE> is NOT touched: it stays key-gated exactly as it is, which is what keeps the hide/restore moderation path intact. Droppable sub-parts if the slice over-runs: the /rooms 'Watch live' affordance and the one-line cold-start room materialization.

selection.rationale: CARD-015 (public /live/<CODE> watch page) is the top-scoring gate-passing card on the stated formula (9 x 7 / 2 = 31.5, ahead of CARD-003 and CARD-004 at 30) and it is the largest available advance on 'people draw together and can find each other'. Slicing changed its economics: CARD-012 was blocked as effort 5 partly because it looked like a safety/moderation build, but the inspection this cycle found the moderation work already SHIPPED — the public read-only spectator socket exists at server.js:3419-3471 and is already carrying the homepage preview and Storyboard previews, already restricted to kid_safe + listed rooms, already capped at 40, already ignoring every inbound frame, already headcount-only. What was missing was an ADDRESS: today the only public watching you can do is in a homepage carousel nobody can share, and /watch/<CODE> (the one shareable URL shape) is the admin glass room behind a key. Phase 1 therefore adds no protocol, no auth, no data exposure and no moderation surface: a lazy PublicWatch.jsx over the existing socket, one Router branch, a 'Watch live' link on /rooms cards that already report people present, and one line to materialize featured rooms on a cold start. It converts watchers into participants at the exact moment they can see someone drawing, and it feeds directly into CARD-016 (counted watchers — the count is already tracked in room.spectators but never surfaced), so pick 1 of this slice leaves the next slice nearly free. Risk posture is deliberately conservative for the day's LAST patch: /watch/<CODE> is untouched (admin key, modwatch, hide/restore all intact), private/unlisted rooms stay unwatchable by existing server rules, watchers get a client-only animal alias and can never chat, and every acceptance item is a screenshot or a two-client socket assertion. Effort 2 sits exactly at the gate, and the two sub-parts most likely to over-run (→ /rooms 'Watch live' link, cold-start materialization) are named as droppable in the card so a human can cut them without losing the route.
selection.runner_up: CARD-003 (onboarding step 4 teaches the invite loop, effort 1, score 30) — the safest possible patch, but its impact is contained to first-run users who are already in the app; the spectator slice reaches people BEFORE they sign up.
selection.budget_note: 5 auto-patches/day. Used after this selection: CARD-001, CARD-013, CARD-002, CARD-014, CARD-015 = 5 of 5 — the auto-patch budget for the day is EXHAUSTED. Cycle 5 of max 6. CARD-016 is gate-passing (effort 2) and is the natural cycle-6 pick if a fresh day/window opens; CARD-017/CARD-018/CARD-009/CARD-010 all require human-reviewed patches.
selection.phase_split_note: Cycle 5 spent two of its slots on board work rather than code: CARD-011 and CARD-012 were rewritten as phased parents so the owner's 2026-09-16 moderation waiver can be spent in gate-legal increments instead of one effort-5 patch.
